words.definition: The art of performing in a play or movie
words.definationTranslation: एक नाटक या फिल्म में अभिनय करने की कला

sentence.sentence: She has a talent for acting and has been in several plays.

sentence.sentence: He took acting classes to improve his public speaking skills.
sentence.translation: उन्होंने अपने सार्वजनिक बोलने कौशल में सुधार करने के लिए अभिनय कक्षाएं लीं।

words.definition: A series of movements performed to music

sentence.translation: उसे नृत्य करना पसंद है और वह हर हफ्ते कक्षाएं लेती है।

sentence.translation: वह आराम करने के लिए हर दिन संगीत बजाती है।

words.definition: A performance of a story on stage

sentence.translation: बच्चों ने अपने माता-पिता के लिए एक नाटक किया।

sentence.sentence: She will choreograph the dance for the school play.

words.definition: A practice session for a performance

words.definition: The area where performances take place

words.definition: The people who watch a performance
words.definationTranslation: वे लोग जो एक प्रदर्शन देखते हैं

sentence.sentence: The audience was wowed by the magic show.
sentence.translation: दर्शक जादू शो से प्रभावित हुए।

sentence.sentence: The play was well-received by the audience.
sentence.translation: नाटक दर्शकों द्वारा अच्छी तरह से प्राप्त किया गया था।

words.definition: The person in charge of a performance or production

words.definition: The written version of a performance
words.definationTranslation: एक प्रदर्शन का लिखित संस्करण

sentence.sentence: The actors studied the script before the rehearsal.
sentence.translation: अभिनेताओं ने अभ्यास से पहले पटकथा का अध्ययन किया।

sentence.translation: पर्दा खुल गया और सेट का पता चला।

sentence.sentence: The play began when the curtain rose.

words.definition: An object used on stage to create a realistic setting

sentence.sentence: The prop department created a realistic sword.
sentence.translation: प्रॉप विभाग ने एक वास्तविक तलवार बनाई।

sentence.sentence: The actors used props to enhance the scene.
sentence.translation: अभिनेताओं ने दृश्य को बढ़ाने के लिए प्रॉप्स का उपयोग किया।

words.definition: The clothes and accessories worn by actors on stage
words.definationTranslation: मंच पर अभिनेताओं द्वारा पहने जाने वाले कपड़े और सहायक उपकरण

sentence.sentence: The costume designer created beautiful outfits.
sentence.translation: पोशाक डिजाइनर ने सुंदर पोशाकें बनाईं।

sentence.sentence: The actors wore elaborate costumes to the premiere.
sentence.translation: अभिनेताओं ने प्रीमियर में विस्तृत पोशाकें पहनी थीं।

sentence.sentence: She wore a lot of makeup to the party.

words.definition: The use of light to create a mood or atmosphere

words.definition: The use of noise or music to create a mood or atmosphere

sentence.sentence: The sound effects were very realistic.
sentence.translation: ध्वनि प्रभाव बहुत वास्तविक थे।

sentence.sentence: The sound system in the theater was excellent.

words.definition: Illusions or tricks used to create a realistic setting

sentence.sentence: The special effects in the movie were amazing.
sentence.translation: फिल्म में विशेष प्रभाव अद्भुत थे।

sentence.sentence: The play used special effects to create a magical atmosphere.

words.definition: A performance that tells a story, often with a serious tone
words.definationTranslation: एक प्रदर्शन जो एक कहानी बताता है, अक्सर एक गंभीर स्वर के साथ

sentence.sentence: The drama club at school was very popular.
sentence.translation: स्कूल में नाटक क्लब बहुत लोकप्रिय था।

sentence.translation: नाटक एक नाटक था जिसमें प्रेम और हानि के विषयों का अन्वेषण किया गया था।

words.definition: A performance that is meant to be humorous

sentence.sentence: The comedy show was hilarious.
sentence.translation: हास्य शो हँसाने वाला था।

sentence.sentence: The play was a comedy that poked fun at everyday life.
sentence.translation: नाटक एक हास्य था जिसने दैनिक जीवन का मजाक उड़ाया।

words.definition: A performance that tells a sad or unfortunate story

sentence.sentence: The tragedy of the play was very moving.

sentence.sentence: The story of the movie was a tragedy that ended in sadness.
sentence.translation: फिल्म की कहानी एक त्रासदी थी जो दुख में समाप्त हुई।

words.definition: A performance that is created on the spot without planning

sentence.sentence: The improv group was very funny.

sentence.sentence: The actors had to use improv to fill in the gaps.

words.definationTranslation: एक प्रकार का नृत्य जिसमें सटीक गतिविधियाँ शामिल हैं

sentence.sentence: The ballet company performed a beautiful routine.
sentence.translation: बैले कंपनी ने एक सुंदर दिनचर्या का प्रदर्शन किया।

sentence.sentence: She took ballet classes to improve her posture.
sentence.translation: उसने अपने मुद्रा में सुधार करने के लिए बैले कक्षाएं लीं।
